verdict.rationale: Vercel documents automatic preview environments on every push, with a preview URL for every branch, so each team member's branch gets its own deployment. It also supports custom environments with per-environment variables and team commenting on previews, which together cover the core of parallel shipping. missing for 10: explicit evidence that environment counts are unlimited, documentation of how isolated previews are from each other (e.g., per-preview data or backing services), independent or hands-on corroboration.
